只是我为 SwarmUI 的简单选项卡制作的一组工作流程...只是为了让事情变得更快！

如何使用！：

  1. 转到“舒适工作流程”选项卡并在工作流程中加载

  2. 单击 Swarm 为您提供的“保存工作流程”按钮

  3. 确保启用“在简单选项卡中启用”并单击“保存工作流程”

  4. 转到简单选项卡并选择您刚刚保存的工作流程！

  5. 啊啊啊啊啊啊你准备好开始了！ ：D

o.en:
IMPORTANT!:

These workflows are designed for SwarmUI's Simple tab. They probably won't work in the original version of ComfyUI. If you want to use these workflows, You NEEDSwarmUI

Just a bundle of workflows I made for SwarmUI's simple tab... just to make things faster!

HOW TO USE!:

  1. Go to the "Comfy Workflow" tab and load in the workflow

  2. Click the "Save Workflow" button that Swarm gives you

  3. Make sure to enable "Enable in Simple Tab" and click "save workflow"

  4. Go to the simple tab and select the workflow you just saved!

  5. aaaaaaaaaaand you're ready to gen! :D
